description: Operational Event schema v1 data dictionary for AI Ops analytics.

envelopeFields.name: event_id
envelopeFields.description: Globally unique idempotent key for the event.

envelopeFields.name: event_type
envelopeFields.description: Immutable event name from the Phase 0 taxonomy.

envelopeFields.name: schema_version
envelopeFields.description: Envelope schema version. Current value is 1.

envelopeFields.name: occurred_at
envelopeFields.description: Business time when the fact happened.

envelopeFields.name: correlation_id
envelopeFields.description: Join key across conversation, issue, route, feedback, and cost.

envelopeFields.name: issue_type_id
envelopeFields.description: Issue taxonomy id when the event is issue-scoped.

envelopeFields.name: actor_ref
envelopeFields.description: Pseudonymous actor reference. Never raw PII.

envelopeFields.name: masking_policy_version
envelopeFields.description: Masking rules version applied before persistence.

envelopeFields.name: retention_expires_at
envelopeFields.description: Firestore TTL field for operational events.

envelopeFields.name: payload
envelopeFields.description: Event-specific masked fields. Must not contain credentials.

idempotency.rule: Duplicate event_id writes must not change analytics counts.
